job.description:
Premium Logo Design for Muay Thai Compression Apparel Brand (Embroidery + Screen Print Ready)

ABOUT LONGUARD
 
LONGUARD is a premium DTC compression apparel brand engineered specifically for Muay Thai fighters and serious combat athletes. We're launching with a compression long-sleeve shirt ($75 USD retail) designed for clinch work, heavy bag training, and pad work. Our positioning is high-performance meets authentic athlete story, we're not a lifestyle brand, we're a fighter's brand.
 
Brand DNA:
- Founder-led: Built by a Muay Thai athlete, for Muay Thai athletes
- Performance-first: Every design choice serves both aesthetics and function
- Premium positioning: Competing with Hound ($79), Gymshark ($65-125), not mall brands
- Authentic storytelling: We're documenting the building process, not hiding behind marketing
 
 
WHAT WE NEED
 
A primary logo that will appear on:
- Chest of compression long-sleeve (embroidered, ~2-2.5cm width) since it will be embroidered it will rest above the fabric therefore avoid sharp/thing edges as much as possible as that may be susceptible to peeling or dangerous when embroidered
- Brand materials (website, emails, packaging)
- Works equally well at large scale (website hero) and tiny scale (sleeve embroidery)
 
---
 
THE VISUAL DIRECTION
 
Style: Clean, geometric, vector-based. Think premium minimalism: like Gymshark, Fabletics, Lululemon, Descente wordmark. NOT complex illustrations or aggressive imagery.
 
Vibe:
- Timeless (won't look dated in 3 years)
- Premium but approachable
- Reflects compression/armor concept without being literal
- Monochromatic stealth aesthetic (works in black, white, silver)
- Professional, not edgy or gatekeeping
 
AVOID:
- Tiger imagery (too close to Venum, overused in combat sports)
- Skulls or aggressive/dark symbols (wrong positioning for premium)
- Script fonts or cursive (too casual)
- Complex line work or gradients (won't embroider cleanly)
- Overly trendy elements (dates quickly)
 
 
DESIGN DIRECTION OPTIONS (Designer chooses or proposes own)
 
Option A: Clean Wordmark + Accent
- "LONGUARD" in clean sans-serif (Futura, Montserrat, or custom)
- Small geometric accent (vertical bar, circle, or stripe) below or beside
- Represents: Structured, professional, brand-forward
- Reference: Gymshark wordmark simplicity
 
Option B: Geometric Icon + Wordmark
- Simple icon (representing compression zones, armor plating, or rising strength)
- "LONGUARD" wordmark integrated below
- Icon works standalone on sleeve, wordmark on chest
- Represents: Functional design, performance-driven
- Reference: Lululemon wordmark with accent line
 
Option C: Hybrid (Icon dominant, text secondary or absent)
- Pure geometric mark (no text, lets icon carry the brand)
- Small "LONGUARD" below in tiny text
- Icon is the hero, works at all scales
- Represents: Bold, confident, minimalist
- Reference: Apple, Nike swoosh simplicity
 
Option D: Custom Direction
- If you have a better idea that fits the brief, propose it. We want creativity.
 
---
 
TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
 
Deliverables:
1. Vector file (AI or EPS, editable)
2. High-res PNG (transparent background, 300 DPI minimum)
3. Embroidery-ready version (single-color, simplified for embroidery digitization)
4. Screen-print version (simple outline, printer-friendly)
5. Multiple scales (prove it works at: 1cm, 2.5cm, 10cm, 20cm+)
6. Color variations (Black, white, silver/reflective)
 
Constraints:
- Monochromatic primary (black, white, or silver only for primary use)
- Works in 1-color (embroidery requirement)
- Clean curves (no thin details that get lost in embroidery)
- Scalable (looks good at 1cm on sleeve, looks good at 50cm on website)
- Font-agnostic (if using type, must be licensed or custom)
 
---
 
BRAND CONTEXT
 
What LONGUARD Represents:
- Compression zones engineered for Muay Thai: Core, shoulders, hips, thighs optimized for clinch work and striking
- Armor aesthetic: Not literal armor, but structural protection (mental + physical)
- "Rise again" ethos: Muay Thai philosophy (some rounds are hard, some are won, but we rise)
- International community: Built by athletes for athletes across Asia-Pacific, US, EU
 
Who We're Competing With (Reference Tone, Not Style):
- Hound.ac: Reflective, high-end, gaming/quest narrative
- Gymshark: Approachable premium, athlete-forward, creator-driven
- Hayabusa: Fight-sport specific, performance-obsessed
 
Who We're NOT:
- Lifestyle luxury (not Alo Yoga, Lululemon aspirational wellness)
- Generic fitness (not Nike, Under Armour broad appeal)
- Streetwear (not Supreme, Stüssy cultural cargo)
 
---
 
DESIGN BRIEF CHECKLIST
 
Your design should feel:
- Premium (luxury athletic brand, not mall fitness)
- Timeless (won't look dated by 2028)
- Embroidery-friendly (clean lines, minimal thin details)
- Scalable (works at 1cm and 100cm without losing integrity)
- Minimal (less is more; remove anything that doesn't serve a purpose)
- Authentic (reflects Muay Thai/fighter culture, not generic sports)
- Monochromatic-first (beautiful in black before adding color)
 
---
 
INSPIRATION REFERENCES (Reference Tone/Approach, Not Direct Copy)
 
Wordmark + Accent:
- Gymshark logo (clean sans-serif + geometric accent)
- Lululemon wordmark (simple, professional, timeless)
 
Geometric Icon:
- Everlane mark (minimal, geometric, works at all scales)
- Allbirds mark (simple, nature-inspired but abstract)
 
Monochromatic Premium:
- Nike swoosh (one curve, infinite scale, timeless)
- Supreme box logo (simplicity, confidence, cultural weight)
 
---
 
TIMELINE
 
Round 1: 5-7 days for initial concepts (3 directions minimum)
Feedback: 1 revision round with specific notes
Final: 3-5 days for final refinements
Total: 10-14 days from start to delivery
 
---
 
BUDGET
 
$200-300 USD
- Includes: Unlimited rounds within scope (wordmark + one geometric element max)
- Includes: All deliverable formats (vector, PNG, embroidery version, screen print version)
- Ownership: Full rights to the design (LONGUARD owns it)
 
Potential for Long-Term Partnership:
If this logo is strong, we'll likely need secondary logo variations, apparel graphic designs for future drops, and potential retainer-style relationship as we scale.
 

 
HOW TO APPLY
 
In your Upwork proposal, please include:
 
1. Your portfolio link (emphasize any: wordmark design, athletic wear branding, minimalist work, embroidery-aware design)
2. Why you fit LONGUARD (1-2 sentences on why this brand resonates with you or your experience)
3. Your design approach (How would you interpret "premium minimalist compression apparel logo"? No full design yet, just your thinking)
4. Timeline (Confirm you can deliver in 10-14 days)
5. Questions for clarity (Ask anything that helps you nail the brief)
 
---
 
OUR DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
 
We believe the logo should:
- Disappear into the brand (it's a tool, not the hero)
- Work harder when small (embroidery on sleeve should punch as hard as a 50cm website hero)
- Age gracefully (good design from 2026 should look good in 2030)
- Feel earned (not a generic sports logo; reflect the specificity of Muay Thai + compression)
 
---
 
FINAL NOTE
 
We're a scrappy, founder-led brand building in public. This logo will be seen by thousands of people—fighter communities, athletes, creators. We're not looking for a trend-chasing design; we're looking for a timeless mark that carries our brand for years.
 
If you're excited about designing for a real athlete brand (not a corporate refresh), and you understand that simplicity is strength, we want to work with you.
 
If you have any questions feel free to reach out.
